transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’m having trouble talking right. Like my words don’t stay in order. I’ll start telling someone about an overnight shift, and then I’m suddenly on soccer, or paint colors, or patient charts, and people look like they can’t follow me.
Have you been feeling unusually high or overly energetic lately?
Not really. I mean… I don’t think so. I haven’t felt, like, unusually up or anything.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
I… don’t think so. Not like a voice talking to me, no. I haven’t really noticed that.
Have you had any recent medical or neurological illness, like a head injury or seizure?
Um… no, I don’t think so. Nothing like that that I know of.
Do you believe that anyone is trying to harm you or plot against you?

I don’t know if I’d say harm exactly… but yeah, I think people at work are keeping an eye on me. Like my supervisors changing my shifts on purpose, watching me through the unit cameras, saying it’s just staffing… but I don’t really believe that.
Have you had a period of feeling very depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s like this heavy, empty feeling is already there. After work sometimes I just sit in my car and cry for a while before I can drive home.
Have there been times when people were watching or tracking you even when you were not feeling depressed?
Yeah… there were a few weeks where I wasn’t feeling as low as usual. But I still felt like the cameras and supervisors were watching me, and I was pretty guarded at work.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energetic or wired for several days in a row?
Not really… I mean, I’ve had nights I didn’t sleep great, but I wouldn’t say I felt wired for days or anything.
Have there been times when you felt watched or tracked even when you were not feeling depressed at all?

Yeah… there was a stretch, maybe a few weeks, where I wasn’t really in that deep depressed place. But I still felt like the cameras and supervisors were watching me, so I stayed pretty guarded at work.
Have you ever had a time when you felt unusually energetic or unusually confident for several days in a row?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve had times I couldn’t sleep much, but not like I felt unusually confident or full of energy for days.
Have you found yourself talking much less than usual, even when you want to say more?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes I get quiet, but I haven’t really noticed it like that.
During the time these problems have been going on, has depression been present most of the time?
Yeah… I think so. Looking back, that heavy empty feeling, and not really caring about things… it’s been there most of the time, even when the other stuff wasn’t as loud.
Was there ever a time when you felt watched or tracked while you were not depressed at all?
Yeah… there was a few weeks like that. I wasn’t really in the deep depressed place then, but I still felt like the cameras and supervisors were keeping track of me. I was pretty guarded at work.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being controlled by someone or something outside of you?

Not exactly like… controlling my thoughts. It’s more like I’m sure my supervisors are changing my shifts and watching me through the unit cameras, like they’re checking if I’m unsafe. People say it’s just staffing shortages, but… I don’t really believe that.
Have you ever seen things that other people could not see?
I don’t think so. Not really… nothing I’d call seeing things.
Looking back over the whole time these problems have been going on, has depression been present for most of that time?
Yeah… I think so. The heavy, empty feeling’s been there most of the time, even when the camera stuff wasn’t as bad. Like, I still didn’t really care about much.
Was there ever a time when you felt watched or tracked for at least two weeks while you were not depressed at all?

Yeah… I think there was a few weeks like that. I wasn’t in that really deep depressed place then, but I still felt like the cameras and supervisors were keeping track of me. I was still careful at work… guarded, I guess.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah. I mean… I used to draw, like sketch murals, and I’d cook for friends sometimes. Played soccer on weekends too. Now it just feels kind of pointless, so I mostly ignore people’s messages and stay in my apartment.
Have you noticed your facial expression feeling blank or people telling you that you seem emotionally flat?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed my face much. I don’t think anyone’s said it like that to me.
Have other people told you that you seem emotionally flat or show very little facial expression?
Not really. I mean… nobody’s told me that directly. I don’t pay much attention to my face, I guess.
